hook.text: Disney pitched Zootopia as a buddy-cop comedy starring a rabbit and a fox in a city of animals.

buildup.text: The lighthearted premise masked a surprisingly sharp examination of prejudice and systemic bias.

discovery.text: The film addressed profiling, stereotyping, and fear of the other through an animal world metaphor.

twist.text: Zootopia earned over $1 billion. Talking animals delivered one of Disney's smartest scripts.

climax.text: The movie showed that Disney animation could tackle complex social themes without sacrificing fun.

punchline.text: Talking animals taught the world about prejudice.

quiz.question: What made Zootopia more than a typical animated comedy?
options: It used its animal world as a metaphor to explore prejudice, profiling, and systemic bias
It featured a celebrity voice cast
